map.客户标准符合性判定：按买家明示等级（如耐洗 4 级、耐摩 3-4 级）逐项核对。: Customer standard compliance judgement: check item by item against the buyer's stated grades (for example wash fastness grade 4, abrasion grade 3-4).
map.服装常侧重耐洗与耐摩，户外侧重耐光；权重可按用途设置，默认建议短板优先、加权参考: Garments usually emphasise wash and abrasion fastness while outdoor gear emphasises light fastness; weights can be set by use case, and the default advice is to weight the weakest dimension and read it as a reference.
map.染料与工艺选型对比：不同染料/固色工艺下三项牢度组合比较，择优。: Compare dye and process options: compare the three fastness values under different dyes and fixation processes and pick the better one.
map.染色成品质量检验：三项分级后取最低项作为综合合格依据，防止单强项掩盖弱项。: Quality inspection of dyed goods: grade all three and take the lowest as the overall pass criterion, so a single strong property cannot mask a weak one.
map.活性染色布三项牢度评估示例: Example of three fastness assessments for reactive dyed fabric
map.综合评分和短板项哪个为准？: Does the composite score or the weakest item govern?
map.色牢度以最低短板项为准更安全，避免某项过差被平均掩盖；本工具同时给加权综合与短板: Taking the weakest dimension as the criterion is safer, so a single bad property cannot be hidden by averaging; this tool gives both a weighted composite and the weakest dimension, and the pass judgement uses the weakest.
map.色牢度组合评估 使用指南: Colour fastness combined assessment user guide
map.评定时允许半级记录，工具支持半级输入并参与分级，符合 GB/T 系列评级惯例。: Half steps are allowed in grading; the tool accepts half steps and includes them in grading, following GB/T series rating conventions.
map.输入耐洗、耐摩（干摩）、耐光色牢度等级，综合评估色牢度（1～5 级，5 级最好）: Enter wash, rub (dry rub) and light fastness grades to assess colour fastness overall (grade 1–5, 5 is best)
map.：耐洗 4 级、耐干摩 4-5 级、耐湿摩 3 级、耐光 5 级，加权综合约 4: : wash fastness grade 4, dry rub grade 4-5, wet rub grade 3, light fastness grade 5 give a weighted composite of about grade 4, but the weakest dimension, wet rub grade 3, is below the customer requirement of grade 3-4, so it fails and fixation or the process needs strengthening.
